scope: Germany V9 first-pass CPO tariff audit
guardrails: No tariff generalized beyond the explicit official source scope.
Third-party station data is discovery/supporting evidence only unless the official CPO source confirms the tariff.
Previously deferred CPOs are not re-audited without new evidence.

cpos.direct_payment: Official page confirms QR-code ad-hoc charging without a special tariff contract, paid by credit card.
cpos.scope_note: The official ad-hoc table explicitly applies to Stadtwerke Ratingen charging stations. Overnight AC standing fee is published as free from 22:00 to 06:00.

cpos.direct_payment: Official FAQ confirms QR-code ad-hoc charging without registration or card, paid by Mastercard or Visa.
cpos.reason: The current official ad-hoc table publishes an own-station AC energy price but no own-station DC energy price. Stadtwerke Langenfeld put its first DC fast charger into service on 2026-09-01 with two connectors up to 75 kW, so the newly live DC EVSE cannot be priced exactly from the published table.
cpos.unlock_needed: Resolve the public QR/payment checkout for the Rathausparkplatz DC EVSEs or obtain an updated official own-DC ad-hoc tariff row mapping the exact DC energy price.

cpos.direct_payment: Official pages confirm spontaneous app/QR charging without a contract, paid by credit card or PayPal.
cpos.reason: The official numeric tariff shown on the current page is explicitly the ladeBERT card tariff. The ad-hoc QR/app flow is documented separately without a numeric direct-payment tariff, so card prices are not reused as ad-hoc prices. Third-party station pricing remains discovery evidence only.
cpos.unlock_needed: Capture a public Velbert QR/ladenetz checkout per EVSE or an official Stadtwerke Velbert ad-hoc tariff page/feed with exact direct-payment energy and blocking components.
